compiled_state.title: T5a: RED — Write integration test for verifier JSON -> check-verifier-verdict.sh contract
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Goal
Write an integration test that validates the full contract: completion-verifier-format JSON → check-verifier-verdict.sh exit codes. This ensures the script correctly handles realistic verifier output (not just synthetic unit fixtures). Requires T2 (check-verifier-verdict.sh must exist to run these tests).

## Files to Create
- tests/scripts/test-verifier-integration.sh

## Test Cases
1. Realistic verifier JSON blob with P1=PASS → check-verifier-verdict.sh exits 0
2. Realistic verifier JSON blob with P1=FAIL → check-verifier-verdict.sh exits 1
3. Realistic verifier JSON blob with P1=BLOCKED → check-verifier-verdict.sh exits 1
4. Realistic verifier JSON blob with schema_version=2, P1=INCONCLUSIVE → check-verifier-verdict.sh exits 1
5. Realistic verifier JSON blob missing P1 entirely (schema_version=1 legacy format) → exits 2

## Acceptance Criteria
- chmod +x tests/scripts/test-verifier-integration.sh
- bash tests/scripts/test-verifier-integration.sh exits 0 (all cases pass against real check-verifier-verdict.sh)
- JSON fixtures embedded in test script; match realistic completion-verifier.md output shape

## Testing Mode
RED (depends T2; T5 depends on this task)
